text.offer: You wish the blessing of the land through our Lord Faren. You must prove that you are worthy of his blessings. Take this message to Tova, the bartender of Marion: "You have defiled the land with your ways. The land gives life, yet you treat it as the enemy to be conquered. Embrace nature, do not spurn it like a forgotten lover. Repent your ways. Follow the words of Faren." Return quick to notify me when you are done and perhaps Faren will favor you with power.
text.complete: The gaze of Faren is upon you. You have done well. Seek me when you would learn more of his ways and his spells.

steps.objective: Bring Faren's words to Tova in Marion
